div.span:
Heartbeat: each worker beats only after a full round trip through Temporal; silence pages (warden-ops-heartbeat-missing).
Synthetic: once a day a recorded incident runs through the model and the gate in shadow; 25 hours without a pass pages.
actor-use: every AssumeRole of an actor role is checked against the audit; an unapproved one pages. A change to the approver list pages too.
All pages go to SNS warden-ops-page → e-mail.
